mc_design: One fixed bank of32 uniform exactly-half channel masks, reused for all conditions/layers; both raw-half and doubled-half errors. Report mean/SE and analytic expectations, no outcome selection.
numeric: Metrics use float64 differences of actual saved native float32 products. Expansion uses float64 normalized inputs and weights; numerical disagreement reported against actual native product/write differences. Null/identity denominators explicit.
